title: Lidar capture
buildSteps: the lidar and the scene, with the scene's video of propagating light playing
one measurement: the pulse, its direct return, and the indirect light, with the plot swept once; then the time of flight marked
the measurements at three other visible points, each with its wavefronts and its peaks
the scan over the visible surfaces, the video filling in the scan's order and playing, its light drawn faintly on the scene
